core_principles: Clarity and Authority: The UI must convey trust and official government presence without being overly complex.
High Accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets at least WCAG AA standards. Never compromise readability for aesthetics.
Minimalist Precision: No unnecessary decorative elements. Every visual choice (borders, spacing, color) must serve a functional purpose.
Mobile-First Flat Design: Avoid heavy shadows or glassmorphism. Rely on crisp borders and distinct background colors to separate content.

primary.description: Primary Green - Used for main actions, active states, and prominent headers.

secondary.description: Deep Emerald - Used for secondary headers, critical text, and hover states of primary elements.

accent.description: Accent / Success - Used for success badges (e.g., 'Hired' status), positive indicators, and secondary call-to-actions.

background.description: Main background uses Light Background (#ECFDF5). Secondary/Neutral Surface (#F8FAFC) for alternating sections or modals. Cards use Card Highlight (#D1FAE5).

text.description: Text Dark (#064E3B) for all main typography. Never use generic black. Ensure high contrast.

border.description: Used for dividers, card borders, and input outlines.

rules: Maintain a 2-step hierarchy gap between headings and body text.
Use explicit hover states for all interactive text.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mobile-first, single column for phones, max 2-column bento grids for tablets/desktop views.
spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto px-4 md:max-w-2xl md:px-6 (optimized for mobile app feel)

buttons.primary: bg-[#047857] hover:bg-[#065F46] text-white font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-lg w-full transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#ECFDF5] border border-[#047857] text-[#047857] hover:bg-[#D1FAE5] font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-lg w-full transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#22C55E] hover:bg-[#047857] text-white font-medium px-4 py-3 rounded-lg transition-colors

cards.base: bg-[#D1FAE5] border border-[#A7F3D0] rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-3

inputs.base: bg-white border border-[#A7F3D0] text-[#064E3B] rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 w-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#047857] focus:border-transparent placeholder:text-[#A7F3D0]

badges.pending: bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#064E3B] border border-[#064E3B] px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold
badges.for_review: bg-[#D1FAE5] text-[#047857] border border-[#047857] px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold
badges.rejected: bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#064E3B] px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold opacity-75
badges.hired: bg-[#22C55E] text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold shadow-sm

interactive_rules.hover_states: All buttons and links must have a noticeable background or text color shift. Do not rely solely on cursor changes.
interactive_rules.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-button'`).
interactive_rules.animations: Keep animations minimal. Use quick (150ms) ease-in-out transitions for opacity and background-color.

media.guidelines: Use photography that represents real, professional interactions in the Philippines or similar formal settings. No overly abstract or neon imagery.

implementation_notes: Follow the provided color hex codes and keep the interface visually consistent with PESO-Link MisOr's government service context.
Build screens with a mobile-first approach and keep tap targets at least 44x44px.
Prioritize readability, contrast, clear labels, and straightforward navigation.
Use the existing shared UI components and status colors before adding new styling patterns.
Forms such as the NSRP profile should use clear labels and distinct input borders.
Interactive React Native elements should keep stable testID values for testing.
